Two things to check, in this order. First, confirm the GitHub secret CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN holds the token whose id is 0588ba27362792672f5dfca9f351c4c0 - a valid old deploy token also verifies 200, so a passing verify does not mean the secret was replaced. Second, if that is the right token, re-open it in the dashboard and confirm the Workers AI permission was saved through to the end rather than left on the edit screen
